contexts.text: Stay thou not in all the plain () = that he should not delay in any of those doctrinal things.
They cannot stay in the presence of the good.
Stand to meet him near the bank of the river () = influx according to the state. To stand to meet = influx.
Stand thou before Pharaoh () = the appearance of the Divine to those who are in evils... To stand before anyone = presence, here the appearance of the Divine, because Moses was to stand.
And they stood before Pharaoh () = in the presence of those who are infesting.
Rise early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh () = the elevation of the attention of those who are infesting through presence.
Stand still and see the salvation of Jehovah () = salvation by the Lord alone, and none by them... To stand still and see = to have faith.
Tomorrow I will stand upon the head of the hill () = conjunction of truth Divine with the good of charity, and influx thence... To stand = to be conjoined and to flow in. Explained.
Thou mayest endure () = abode with them.
And they stood in the lower parts of the mount () = far from the good of celestial love.
Consistence and subsistence. Signified.
The staves must be in the rings of the ark = that power is steadfast from the Divine sphere of good and truth.
And the table shall be carried with them = steadfastness thence... To be carried = to exist and subsist, thus to consist or be steadfast.
The boards shall be twinned below to one ring = consistence, or steadfastness. A ring = conjunction, here, steadfastness through conjunction.
And thou shalt stand before Me there upon the head of the mount () = from the inmost Heaven where is the Divine love.
And Jehovah descended in a cloud, and stood with him there () = the external of the Word in which is the Divine... To stand with Moses there, when said of Jehovah, = the Divine in it.
Heaven consists of innumerable Societies. General article.
Ideas which consist of such things.
The mind consists of two parts...
Marriage love and its delight consist in this...
In this consists love to the Lord...
They believed that heavenly happiness consists in an idle life... But no happiness ever consists in being quiescent...
Heaven consists in this...
There is extension into heavenly Societies if the reigning love consists of the loves of Heaven, but into infernal Societies if it consists of the loves of Hell.
The ultimate plane consists of...
Consist of degrees discrete and continuous... DLW 226:end.
Who shall be able to stand () = that they would not be able to endure.
This age would not stand, as iron stands. Signified.
The will and understanding; of these two the mind of everyone consists.
In the Church there are two essentials, charity and faith, from which each and all things of it consist.
Perfection of life does not consist in thought...
The universe consists from perpetual uses...
Every man does not actually consist except from such things as are in the earth.
The life of man's spirit consists in his free will in spiritual things. SE 4325.
The communion called the Church consists of as many men as have the Church in them.
The consistence or permanence of all things is dependent upon order.
An intellectual idea exists and consists from many ideas. Explained.
Pressures, and thence consistences...
